newsitem.title: USA: Seafield converts Response Oncology note.
newsitem.headline: Seafield converts Response Oncology note.

text.p: Seafield Capital Corp said Thursday it has converted a $23.5 million Response Oncology Inc note and accrued interest into Response common stock.

The note was converted at $8 per share, resulting in about three million additional shares of Response owned by Seafield. Seafield now owns about 8.1 million shares of Response, or about 67 percent of Response shares outstanding, the company said.

The conversion will increase Response's shareholders equity to about $62 million, and combined with Response's credit facility, should place Response in a solid financial position to pursue the growth of its oncology services, Seafield said.
With the conversion of the note having been completed, Seafield is exploring a possible distribution to its shareholders of all of its Response shares in the second quarter, the company said.
